setting: Counts: acoustic speech reconstruction from intracranial recordings during speech production (the published intracranial-synthesis population). Precedents for the changed design (unit selection): speech synthesized from any non-acoustic signal (neural, EMG, articulatory, ultrasound, video), as in published reviews.

inherited.M01: Overt single-word reading during awake craniotomy (same recordings as Angrick 2019)
inherited.M02: Simultaneously recorded audio as the unit inventory; no phoneme or word labels
inherited.M03: Per-participant, 5-fold word-disjoint cross-validation, 8.3-11.7 min per participant
inherited.M04: Overt reading; offline; causal variant reported for the best participant only
inherited.M05: 64-channel 8x8 ECoG grid, 4 mm, over M1v/PMv/IFG; log high-gamma 70-170 Hz, 450 ms centred context
inherited.M07: None: no lexicon or language model; concatenation cost disabled
inherited.M13: Offline intraoperative recording; runtime under 1 ms per 10 ms window

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (intracranial production-speech acoustic reconstruction, classified by the neural-to-acoustic model). Prior-time tally: studies first public before 2019-05 that reconstruct continuous acoustic or synthesizer parameters from intracranial recordings during produced speech; versions once; reviews, perception and classification studies excluded; Martin 2014 and Chakrabarti 2015 added from the published M12 reconstruction table because the ledger pattern misses them. Design of interest: regression to continuous features versus selection of stored units by neural similarity.

Reused published table (how predicted features become a waveform). Prior-time tally: the intracranial production studies first public before 2019-05 that output a waveform. Precedent check across all non-acoustic signals: whole-wiki full-text pattern for unit selection / concatenative / corpus-based synthesis, hits within 400 characters of a signal term read as snippets.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes unit_selection, neural_vocoder, parametric_vocoder, griffin_lim

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: speech synthesized from non-acoustic signals evaluated by human listeners who transcribe or identify words or sentences; naturalness-only, ASR-only, acoustic-input conversion and review mentions excluded; versions once. Prior-time tally from the table's text-verified include decisions first public before 2019-05.
topics.metric: listener identification accuracy with chance level / transcription WER
